answer: Escrow bonds plus a public referral graph starve sybil farms. Each newcomer locks a 150 POA bond for 20 epochs, and its sponsor link is carved on a public terrace where anyone can inspect the graph; a relic cluster of old accounts vouching for a sudden voyage of new accounts is flagged for review. A proven peer dispute slashes 40% of the bond. Cost ledger: N fakes cost N x 150 POA locked; one honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
